comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Not built. Rows leave the top of libghostty's PageList at six sites (grow prune with a revert path, Limits.enforce, erasing history, the resize trim, reset, reflow). A stable row number has no meaning across reset or reflow, and a counter means edits across the most-changed core file, past what an additive patch should carry.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: pane.read counts rows from the oldest row still held, so once scrollback starts trimming, a row number a caller saved points at different text on the next read. A stable numbering needs a trimmed-row count from libghostty (a C API addition in deps/ghostty-patches). Found in round 2 (slot 2, streams).
title: pane.read: row numbers that stay stable as history is trimmed
